compiled_state.description:
Scope: `src/rebar/_commands/**`, `_cli/**`, `_engine_support/**`, `_io/**`. ~205 lines leave.

Largest cluster, unanticipated: the bash dispatcher is GONE (no `*.sh`, no `ticket_txn.py`) yet ~16 module docstrings still narrate 'Ports ticket-X.sh', 'byte-parity with the dispatcher arm', 'Tier E cutover', 'until E7'. ~126 lines, confirmed stale rather than merely historical. `docs/bash-migration.md` is the existing home.

Verified stale and confirmed individually: `_commands/txn.py:3-8` cites a shim that does not exist; `_engine_support/reads.py:15-19` states a false reason for the module's location; `_commands/leaf.py:9-12` says tag/untag/archive are 'tracked as child tickets' while all three are defined in that same file; `_engine_support/__init__.py:7-9` cites compat shims that do not exist; `_io/__init__.py:14` says the import side 'lands in a later sub-task' six lines above the line importing it; `_cli/_help.py:3-8` is truncated mid-clause (introduced by 3a53e202a7).

`_engine_support/reads_cli.py` explains the same unknown-option rule in five near-identical blocks — a ->CODE fix (extract one helper) rather than a comment edit.

Headroom: `_commands/init.py` 799 -> ~782 (18 lines of margin), `_cli/_llm_commands.py` 789 -> ~778 (22) — both WITHOUT any code extraction. The module-size pressure in these two files is partly caused by comments explaining previous module-size splits.

New ADR proposed: 'Explicit init over silent-implicit tracker creation' — a prior-art survey (git-bug/git-appraise vs git-issue/bugs-everywhere/Fossil) stated in four places.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] Every non-KEEP unit in scope is relocated or deleted per its destination
- [x] The shard's do_not_move list is appended to `.joe-janitor/tools.md` BEFORE any edit lands
- [x] Verified-stale comments are corrected where they document a live invariant, deleted only where obsolete
- [x] No load-bearing invariant is lost

## CORRECTION (plan-review BLOCK, criteria F1/E6)

AC3/AC4 rested on a subjective correct-vs-delete judgment with no decision rule or observable
check. Superseded below with the parent 373f disposition vocabulary and a recorded-reason rule
for every deletion.

## Acceptance Criteria (supersedes the list above)

- [x] Every substantial in-scope comment unit is dispositioned into exactly one of the parent
      373f labels: RELOCATE (to docs/bash-migration.md, an ADR, or a ticket, reduced to a
      one-line citation), DELETE, KEEP, DO_NOT_MOVE, or CORRECT-IN-PLACE.
- [x] Decision rule for CORRECT-vs-DELETE: a stale comment that documents CURRENT runtime
      behavior / a live invariant is CORRECTED in place; a comment is DELETED only when the thing
      it describes no longer exists (referenced artifact removed, or the statement is superseded).
      For each DELETE, the reason (referenced-artifact-gone / superseded) is stated in the commit
      body or a ticket comment, so no comment documenting current behavior is removed without a
      recorded reason.
- [x] The dead bash-dispatcher narration (~16 module docstrings citing 'Ports ticket-X.sh',
      'byte-parity with the dispatcher arm', 'Tier E cutover', 'until E7' — the bash dispatcher
      and ticket_txn.py no longer exist) is relocated to docs/bash-migration.md where still
      useful, or deleted as stale with the reason recorded.
- [x] The individually-confirmed stale comments are CORRECTED or DELETED per the rule above:
      `_commands/txn.py:3-8` (cites a non-existent shim), `_engine_support/reads.py:15-19`
      (false location reason), `_commands/leaf.py:9-12` (tag/untag/archive defined in-file, not
      'tracked as child tickets'), `_engine_support/__init__.py:7-9` (non-existent compat shims),
      `_io/__init__.py:14` (contradicted 6 lines below), `_cli/_help.py:3-8` (truncated clause).
- [x] The `_engine_support/reads_cli.py` five near-identical unknown-option blocks are collapsed
      to one shared helper (behavior-preserving), verified by the existing CLI tests.
- [x] The shard's do_not_move list is appended to `.joe-janitor/tools.md` BEFORE any edit lands;
      lint/type pragmas (`# noqa`, `# type: ignore`, `# ruff:`, `# tickets-boundary-ok`) and
      test-introspected docstrings are DO_NOT_MOVE.
- [x] Any new ADR (e.g. 'Explicit init over silent-implicit tracker creation') EXISTS and is
      committed before any comment citing it is collapsed.
- [x] The actual recovered comment-line count is measured (by diff) and recorded on this ticket
      as an output, not a target.
- [x] No behaviour change: the full test suite AND `make lint` / `make typecheck` pass unchanged.
